notes.title: Quality of life updated 1.0
notes.content: [p]Hey![/p][p]First patch with some quality of life updates just landed:[/p][p]1. Application now supports fullscreen/windowed mode[/p][p]2. Campaign steps now display units which you'll need to fight on it[/p][p]3. You will not be able to click on abilities which are not usable when none of your units died (kings revive, necromancer summon skeleton) [/p]

notes.title: Release!
notes.content: [p]Version 1.0 of the game is available now![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update - 3
notes.content:
Hey!

Demo version of a game just received another update:
[list]
[*] Display list of active units with health on UI
[*] Lot of typos fixed
[*] Some abilities received updated visuals
[*] background animation has been changed
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update - 2
notes.content:
Hey!

Demo version of a game just received another update:
[list]
[*] Movement, selection and ability usages now is based on left mouse button only
[*] Shadows above units now indicates unit alignment
[*] You can unclick the ability by clicking on the ability icon once again 
[*] typos, bugfixes, quality of life improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hey!

Demo version of a game just received a huge update it contains of:
[list]
[*] King received new ability - call to action which allows him to revive one of fallen allies
[*] I've added short tutorial to the game
[*] You can un-select units now by clicking on the empty grid or the unit
[*] Balance changes, to keep the game more fair
[*] As always - many bugfixes
[/list]
